semiconductor_relevance: High — Global Zeus specializes in wet etching and cleaning equipment, which are critical processes in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Global Zeus is a leading manufacturer of wet etching and cleaning equipment for the semiconductor industry, providing advanced solutions that enhance process efficiency and reliability. With over 50 years of experience, the company supports major semiconductor fabs with high-quality equipment and exceptional customer service.
capabilities: Wet etching equipment for silicon nitride and metal etching

regional_presence.Japan: Global Zeus has semiconductor equipment manufacturing and R&D facilities in Japan to develop high-quality products.
regional_presence.South Korea: The company also operates manufacturing and R&D facilities in South Korea.
regional_presence.China: Global Zeus maintains a branch in China to support its customer base.
regional_presence.United States: The company has a sales representative in the US to provide timely support to customers.
